cause: The P1 worktree has no frontend node_modules and the root Vitest configuration resolves its setup file and cache outside the writable worktree; the renderer test could not be executed in the isolated worktree.
impact: TypeScript/Vitest renderer acceptance remains NOT VERIFIED; the component and test only passed esbuild syntax bundling.
lesson: Frontend package dependencies and an isolated test cache must be provisioned before claiming renderer or browser acceptance.
